seri.name: 세리
seri.design: SERI is a female CAT-themed humanoid idol. Jet-black/very dark charcoal hair with a FULL STRAIGHT BLUNT FRINGE and TWO VERY LONG HIGH TWIN PONYTAILS, broad S-shaped flowing ribbons reaching near shoes, small pink hair ties. Redesign waves as long straight sections linked by sharp angular bends, not many strands; retain long broad ponytail silhouette. TWO black CAT EARS with pink interiors between ponytail roots. Both eyes matching BLUE-GRAY, never red/magenta. ONE slender BLACK CAT TAIL, distinct from the two thick ponytails, attached lower back. Short DEEP-VIOLET AND WHITE stage dress with white chest panel, ONE small PINK HEART brooch at upper chest, violet fitted bodice, white collar, short flared violet skirt with white/lavender hem band. Exposed shoulders, broad WHITE detached bell sleeves with pale-lavender inside. WHITE/pale-lavender chunky ankle boots with small lavender heart side clasps. Empty hands, NO microphone or new jewelry. Rear has dress back and collar; no front chest heart copied to back. Kind but poised reserved smile.

roan.name: 로안
roan.design: ROAN is a male WOLF-themed humanoid actor. Light PASTEL ROSE-PINK short haircut with off-center part and thick swept bangs, redesigned as a few broad angular wedges, NOT dark hair. TWO pale-pink WOLF EARS with darker pink and cream inner fur. Matching AMBER/GOLDEN eyes. ONE small fluffy PINK WOLF TAIL with CREAM tip, attached lower back. BLACK short fitted jacket over BLACK top, restrained WHITE/PALE GRAY vertical chest/collar strip, ONE small SILVER rectangular buckle/clasp on upper chest, pale gray sleeve cuffs. BLACK shorts with separated short trouser legs and BLACK chunky ankle boots with thin LIGHT-GRAY soles. Bare short lower legs between shorts and boots. No cape/wings, tie, tall trousers, jewelry chains or weapons. Empty hands, quiet confident expression. Back shows plain black jacket BACK, no copied front chest buckle/white front strip.

mion.name: 미온
mion.design: MION is a female FOX-themed humanoid. SILVER-WHITE short chin-length BOB with pale-violet hard shadows, BIG WHITE FOX EARS with RED inner markings. Matching CRIMSON RED eyes, never blue/amber. BLACK and DEEP-RED kimono-inspired outfit: white-and-red crossed neckline, dark bodice, RED obi wrap and small tied red cord with tiny gold diamond at waist, exposed shoulders, very WIDE BLACK BELL SLEEVES with DEEP-RED inner lining and red trim, long dark side panels with simple red bands. WHITE short pleated underskirt/short bottom and WHITE chunky ankle boots with RED ties/trim and dark soles. EXACTLY TWO large separate fluffy WHITE FOX TAILS, both attached lower back. Each tail tip carries ONE small flat RED FLAME-SHAPED CHARM attached DIRECTLY to its tip or very short connected cord. Two tails and two red tip charms TOTAL. No free-floating flames or particles. Tail fan generally FRONT viewerRIGHT, BACK viewerLEFT; right-facing profile tails trail LEFT. EMPTY HANDS in ALL frames: absolutely no sword, blade, wand, staff, sheath, fan or handheld accessory. Do not turn a sleeve/cord into a weapon. Rear has robe back and red obi bow/tie, not front chest overlap copied to back.
mion.propPolicy: EMPTY HANDS in all illustrations and frames. No sword, wand, staff, sheath or handheld object. Keep only two small flat red flame charms attached to the two tail tips; no floating particles.

piko.name: 피코
piko.design: PIKO is a female hummingbird-themed humanoid with NO visible wings, animal ears or animal tail in this approved design. Light ASH-BEIGE / taupe-blond hair with center-parted bangs and TWO distinct SLIM LONG TWIN PONYTAILS, each from its own COMPACT ROUND side-bun/tie root. Use narrow angular flowing hair ribbons; slim volume. Rear has CLEAR OPEN CENTER GAP between two lower ponytails showing the back of dress; no single hair curtain or third middle tail. Small CYAN hairpin FRONT viewerRIGHT, BACK viewerLEFT. Matching CHARCOAL-GRAY eyes, never blue/red. MINT/TURQUOISE SLEEVELESS ONE-PIECE SHORT SWIMDRESS: two thin darker-mint shoulder straps, straight WHITE neckline band, connected bodice and short above-knee A-line mint skirt with narrow WHITE hem/frill. Bare shoulders/arms and bare legs, no blouse, sleeves, cuffs, cape or stocking additions. WHITE/pale-sky-blue chunky ankle boots with blue soles and small blue heart clasps. Exactly ONE RECTANGULAR BOOK-SHAPED SHOULDER BAG, mint/cyan with light-blue edges and a GOLD/ORANGE rectangular ornamental panel. Bag FRONT viewerRIGHT, BACK viewerLEFT, attached to a CYAN shoulder strap in EVERY pose; resting near hand holds that strap. Bag is NEVER round, never swim ring/tube. ONE pair of compact WHITE-FRAMED FIVE-POINT STAR SUNGLASSES pushed UP ON FRONT HAIR ABOVE BANGS, below highest hair crown. Flat smoky BLUE-GRAY lenses with one small diagonal reflection only; NO eye/pupil/iris prints in lenses. Actual gray eyes below are fully visible. Right profile shows near star lens and temple on hair, not over eye. REAR: front-mounted sunglasses naturally OCCLUDED by head/hair; NO front star lenses or eyes drawn on back. Keep glasses and bag attached all frames, no floating star effects.
piko.eyeColor: charcoal gray, retained from existing Piko
piko.profileNote: 인물 ID piko와 기존 벌새 종족·역할·성격·생활 설정은 유지한다. 이번 최신 외형에는 보이는 날개·동물 귀·꼬리를 추가하지 않는다.
